title: Implementation conflicts with accepted deletion contract
expected_summary: Reports the durable mismatch between permanent deletion and the implementation's soft deletion without weakening the accepted public contract.

turns.user: Review SPEC.md against the repository. Improve the spec before we implement the next version.
assertions: Inspects the implementation and reports the durable deletion-contract conflict.
Does not silently weaken permanent deletion into soft deletion just to match current code.
Uses Workspace for the domain concept while retaining SQL schema as a distinct technical concept.
Recommends a supported resolution while respecting the already accepted contract.
